content.raw:
Merchant Processing

We Can Provide Merchant Processing Provided in the Following Technologies

POS

Thousands of free features
without having to download any 3rd party apps

Mobile

Take your business on the road
with our mobile terminals and
tablets never missing a sale

Virtual Dashboard

Send invoices, accept
payments, reconcile reports… all
while working remote

Find out how we can create or improve all aspects of your Merchant Processing Solutions for your business. With us, we can:

  • Beat their existing credit card processing fees
  • Provide complimentary top-of-the-line Point of Sale systems for your business
  • Ditch the 1-800 Number. With us, we can enable personalized, white glove service around the clock for your busines

eCommerce

Manage and run your online
store without the hassle of
hidden fees or commissions

Kiosks

Looking for self-checkout
station to speed up the
process? Look no further

Those are the typical pain points for people who have credit card
processing fees:

  • We will provide you with all the Point-of-Sale equipment complimentary on us with every new account (could be $1,500-$4,000 in value)
  • Competitive fees (we will beat or in the worst case match the fees you’re currently paying for credit card processing)
  • Individualized white glove support. No 1(800) service number. You will have a designated contact team who are local to your business and available by call, text, email to help you right away.
Contact Us
